reference_spec.heading_separation_definition: signed wrap(base_Link COM XY velocity course minus each retargeted wheel rolling-plane heading)
reference_spec.wheel_heading_definition: world(local +Y wheel axle) crossed with world +Z; independent of axle spin

motion_contract.positions: world Z-up meters, link origins rather than COM
motion_contract.linear_velocities: world-frame original unmerged URDF link COM velocities, m/s
motion_contract.runtime_model_note: Export-model hashes document kinematic provenance, not an actuator/contact contract; apply and audit the shared validation model settings separately.

objective_contract.sideslip_target: held reference body-frame course angle, NOT zero
objective_contract.reference_order: Freeze reference[k] and relative-body targets at pre-action state; evaluate after decimation, before command advances.
objective_contract.pose_semantics: World link-origin position and link wxyz quaternion
objective_contract.velocity_semantics: World original-unmerged-link COM linear velocity and world angular velocity
objective_contract.cost: dt * (sum_positive_reward_weights - sum(weight * raw_term)); no terminal term supplied
surrogate_differences: MuJoCo net contact forces are not identical to PhysX ContactSensor forces; all contacts, including self-contact, are included.
undesired_contacts uses max norm over supplied physical-substep history; omitted history is explicitly an instantaneous surrogate.
MuJoCo-derived 0.95 joint ranges are an approximation unless replaced by Isaac runtime soft_joint_pos_limits in matching joint order.
Body COM offsets/inertias must match the original unmerged USD links; random COM offsets require the same realized model parameters.
Task tilt safety termination and policy action/observation privileges are outside this stage objective.

notes: Untuned full-body CEM NMPC starting configuration; not a successful or real-time controller result.
Prediction scenarios are frozen independently of validation plant friction; one scenario is nominal NMPC, several are finite-scenario NMPC without a robustness certificate.
Use the same height-smooth reward components as the new PPO/SAC task; no old TVLQR Q/R or terminal matrix.
Physics-only initial plan uses bounded bias-force joint feedforward from the reference, not a learned-policy demonstration or TVLQR.
Default 15-step horizon predicts 0.3 seconds at 50 Hz; compute deadlines are reported, not enforced.
MuJoCo soft joint limits and contact sensor forces remain explicitly disclosed surrogates until measured Isaac limits and cross-engine reward checks are available.

Parameterization-only nominal development ablation: freeze the winning initial full plan within each solve and optimize bounded block residuals, updating encoded residual elite moments. No objective, actuator, horizon, search-budget or learned-initialization change.

b5_i3.configuration_hash_definition: SHA-256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; not a settings-file byte hash

report.action_parameterization.baseline: Winning bounded initial FULL plan, or bounded fallback when all initial scores fail; fresh after each warm shift
report.action_parameterization.zero_residual: Exactly represents the initial baseline, not a later improved incumbent
report.action_parameterization.incumbent: Paired stored best encoded residual and decoded full plan
report.action_parameterization.elite_moments: Encoded clipped residual parameters; never re-compress decoded/clipped actions
report.action_parameterization.finite_validation: Before residual encoding clip, before decoded action clip, and for elite moment arithmetic; invalid arithmetic raises
report.action_parameterization.generic_bounds: New mode rejects nonfinite spans and rounded spans failing endpoint saturation; decoded sums must still be finite

packed_state_contract.algorithmic_memory: Physical-substep contact-force history plus first-reward reset flag; not extra robot state or actuators.
packed_state_contract.excluded_integration_state: qacc warm-start and simulator time are cold-reset per prediction interval; no actuator activation state exists in this model.
packed_state_contract.external_applied_forces: Required zero in both predictor and plant; no prescribed root correction.

b5_i3.evidence_scope: Hash-bound recorded reports/traces; source declarations are not independent proof of original simulator internals

solver_diagnostics.optional_diagnostics_scope: Original logs only; projection is of the winning INITIAL baseline, not final selected plan. Missing/null values are never imputed as zero.

timing.scope: Complete recorded controller.action including native worker IPC/solver bookkeeping; plant/logging/model/worker startup excluded
timing.comparison_scope: Saved original-run timings, not a controlled hardware microbenchmark
timing.delay_scope: Physical trace advances exactly four 5ms samples per decision, irrespective of solve wall time; no injected wall-latency delay model

limitations: MuJoCo-only DEVELOPMENT variants, not a sim2sim comparison, frozen controller, statistical success rate or hardware result.
Horizon and block duration may change together; parameterization/search knobs are preserved, not treated as a causal horizon-only experiment.
Full-clip tilt and measured nonwheel contacts are separate diagnostics. XY screens alone do not certify upright controlled execution.
Reference contacts are unmeasured; no grounded/patch-slip labels are inferred by FK. Heading offsets are features, not mismatch gates.
World axes and native clocks are unchanged; no alignment/time warp. The figure shows the demonstrated interval, not synthetic recovery/tail.
